title: Unit Event — Time to Take Off! — Episode6 An Old Story

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD are just about ready to visit the US, where they'll attend the event Taiga and Ken are taking part in. An excited Toya is packing his things when he receives an unexpected message...

rows.Line: A few hours later
New York Academy of Music

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “I see. So you all went to visit that street.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “How was it? What did you think?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “It was very lively, and quite a stimulating experience.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“That's wonderful to hear!
I thought you'd feel that way, since you're all involved in music.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “So, that street hasn't changed at all since my dad's time here as a student?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Yes, that's right.
Being so close to an academy of music, it's always been like that.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Hehe.
Were you surprised to hear that Harumichi liked to go there?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, I was honestly a bit startled...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “As far as I've known, I always thought that he was only interested in classical music.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I never imagined him being so drawn a place where you can hear such a wide variety of music.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Hmm... Yes, well...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “I could tell you more about what he was like back then. Would you like that?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “What he was like back then?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Yes.
Back when we were both students here.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, I'd like that.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Okay, it's story time.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“I'll try to go slow.
Let me know if you'd like me to repeat anything.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Thank you very much.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “We'll do our best since this should be a good test of our listening skills!”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Great.
Now, this might feel like a history lesson to all of you...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “One fateful day, a lone exchange student arrived here on the campus of the New York Academy of Music.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “This school is full of people who have committed their lives to music.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “They spend each day practicing and honing their craft in order to reach the top.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But the sound this exchange student could produce stood above the rest.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad must be the exchange student...)

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Rumors of his talent quickly spread beyond the Classical Music department.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “After getting wind of this student, a certain jazz pianist in training said...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“He sounds like a hoot!
I bet we'll really hit it off if we get a chance to talk about music together.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But actually getting a hold of him would prove very difficult.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “This exchange student was like a monk.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “He spent most of his time in one of the practice rooms, or in the library to read books about classical music...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “And whenever anyone tried to talk with him, he'd always say that he had to practice, and blow them right off.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Wait, that means...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Becoming friends with him must've been really hard...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “That's exactly right! It was like there was a vast ocean around him, and not a single landing to be found.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But one day...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Believe it or not, our exchange student decided to come talk to the jazz pianist.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on... Did he just say that Toya's dad came to talk to him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think so. Umm...
“Was there a reason?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes, it's because I decided to...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Play the classical song which he was practicing, but with a jazzy arrangement. Just a little prank.”

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: This is a practice piece that the composer was kind enough to write for our family. Happy was likely the last thing he felt as he wrote this... So, if you understand that, you should know how to play this song.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Did you actually take a close look at the sheet music, Toya? You need to think more about what was going through the composer's mind. If you did, you would know how to play this piece already. You're done practicing. Go reread the sheet music again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Dad values the composer's thoughts more than anything else. He constantly seeks to achieve a complete understanding of their music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is why he abhors irregular arrangements and improvisations. Because they work counter to that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “How did the exchange student respond?”

rows.Speaker: Young Harumichi
rows.Line: “The key change you threw in at the end was beautiful.”

rows.Speaker: Young Harumichi
rows.Line: “I would love to discuss your performance in more detail.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “After that, we began to chat more often.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “And I came to understand that...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Our exchange student, Harumichi, is a classical musician through and through, but he also loves other genres of music.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't believe it. Are we talking about the same person here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I thought you and your dad fought because all he cares about is classical music, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sh-Shinonome, you've switched back to speaking Japanese.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I don't think Mr. Lloyd needs to know about that part.
After all, he's a friend of Toya's dad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “When I began pursuing street music...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “He was fervently against it.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “He said it doesn't have any artistic value, because it's just a bunch of kids making some noise...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“...
Street music was still considered a very new thing when we were students.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “It was rough around the edges, still taking form... But it made up for it with its energy.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “It screamed of wanting to be heard by others. This desire to latch onto people's ears and never let go.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “To be fair, plenty of excellent music was produced. However, for every good song, there was an equally not-so-good one.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “One day, when Harumichi and I were out for a stroll in the city, we ran into trouble with a group of street singers...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Trouble?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes, they made fun of any music that fell outside of their genre.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “To them, their music was the best, and everything else was garbage.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “They were particularly ruthless when it came to classical music. Apparently, playing ”old and dusty music“ sounded like the opposite of fun.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They thought they were the best? Uh...
“Were they really that good?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “No, I can't sugarcoat it. They really weren't.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“And Harumichi got so mad.
This is just me speculating...”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “But I think that encounter is why he dislikes street music so much now.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“However...
I was telling the truth when I said that he enjoys other genres of music.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I had no idea...
About what happened, or the way he thinks and feels.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was absolutely certain that nothing other than classical music would do for him...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like I know so little about my own father.
